d: At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Through cutting-edge hardware, software, and data science, WHOOP delivers personalized insights that help members optimize recovery, training, sleep, and overall well-being.
WHOOP is seeking a Retail Associate to support the day-to-day operations of WHOOP Qatar, an experiential performance center, research lab, and store located in the heart of Msheireb.

This individual will play a key role in delivering a premium, data-driven member experience, supporting retail operations, and bringing the WHOOP brand to life on the ground. The Retail Associate will engage directly with members, drive membership and retail sales, and ensure operational excellence across extended hours (12 hours per day, 7 days per week). This role reports directly to the Retail Lead, WHOOP Qatar.
q: 2–4 years of retail experience, preferably in premium, luxury, or experiential retail environments.
Strong passion for health, fitness, performance, and technology, with the ability to communicate WHOOP’s value proposition effectively.
Proven ability to deliver elevated customer service and build meaningful relationships with members.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-traffic, extended-hours retail environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a team-oriented mindset.
Basic operational understanding, including POS systems, inventory handling, and sales tracking.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.
r: li
Support the daily retail operations of WHOOP Qatar, ensuring exceptional standards of service, organization, and operational execution.
li
Deliver a premium, data-driven member experience by educating members on WHOOP products, memberships, and insights, tailoring interactions to individual performance goals.
li
Drive revenue through the sale of WHOOP memberships, accessories, apparel, and the signature WHOOP Your Way experience, consistently working toward sales targets.
li
Act as a brand ambassador by upholding WHOOP’s premium standards across member engagement, product presentation, and overall store experience.
li
Assist with visual merchandising, inventory management, restocking, and maintaining a clean, organized, and high-performing retail environment.
li
Support experiential programming and in-store activations, ensuring seamless execution and strong member engagement.
li
Collaborate closely with the Retail Lead and team to maintain alignment with brand, marketing, and operational strategies.
li
Maintain strong attention to detail across daily processes including transactions, reporting, compliance, and store procedures.

d: The Showroom Sales Executive is responsible for handling and facilitating customer enquiries and sales activities within the showroom and through digital channels. The position requires a customer-focused and commercially motivated individual who can sell products, prepare reports, monitor stock information, and follow company policies and procedures.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration/ Marketing or relevant.
2 years of relevant experience in sales and communication role.
Excellent Customer Service and Sales skills.
Professional written and verbal communication skills to effectively promote Nass Commercial’s portfolio.
Basic understanding of digital marketing platforms
Excellent analytical abilities and attention to detail.
r: li
Follow company sales policies, operational procedures, and approval limits.
li
Handle both online and offline sales activities.
li
Prepare sales and inventory reports using approved digital and AI tools.
li
Maintain high standards of showroom appearance and product presentation.
li
Prepare quotations, orders, invoices, and customer records accurately.
li
Achieve assigned individual and showroom sales targets.
li
Follow up on sales leads, open quotations, and pending customer decisions.
li
Monitor product availability and report inventory shortages.
li
Provide professional customer service before, during, and after the sale.
li
Resolve routine customer complaints and escalate serious cases appropriately.
li
Coordinate with internal departments to complete customer orders.
li
Support team members and contribute to a positive sales environment.
li
Develop the necessary skills to supervise the showroom and lead the team.
li
Adhere to Nass Corporation standards and CIG in all marketing activities.
li
To adhere to the requirements of Nass Commercial’s integrated management system (IMS).
